dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: This is a military camp, what's there that isn't noteworthy?

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Still, it's been relatively peaceful around these parts lately — no real flare ups and all. I hope it stays that way...

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: *sigh* Just look at this. How can you make a great sword from this scrap? This is an utter waste of my Ikuhara Art forging techniques!

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: The Ikuhara Art is a newly-founded forging style. Our founder... Well, you're looking at him!

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: I used to be a swordsmith at Tatarasuna. Then an accident occurred at the Mikage Furnace. Many of my colleagues have since left.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: I don't want to leave yet. That's why I joined the Shogun's Army stationed here. I can serve the Shogunate while observing the situation in Tatarasuna.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: After all, the best sword-forging material, Jade Steel, is produced here in Tatarasuna... If you don't have good materials to use as a basis, then no amount of skill will make it easy for you to forge the finest blades.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I'd better go find some proper materials.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you really have to use Jade Steel from Tatarasuna?

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Hey, are you listening to yourself? ...Forget it, you're an outlander. You wouldn't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: The reason why swords from Inazuma are so famous is because of Jade Steel. Swords forged it are tough and durable, yet extremely sharp.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Many samurai and swordsmen in our history made their names using weapons forged from Jade Steel.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Someday, I will use the finest Jade Steel and the forging techniques of the Ikuhara Art to create the best sword in the world!

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Thank you for your kind words. I won't give up.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Recently, I collected some decent ores. There were some leftovers, so if you need them, feel free to take them.
